sourceBasis.preparationMethod: Selected historical facts were converted into structured app records and six practical inspector-note variants without copying source narrative into generator input.

noteVariants.text: At six o’clock contact points, the four-inch inlet and ten-inch outlet pipes have scaled corrosion; their supports are corroded and perforated. No plinth seal is fitted to the edge projection. Earthing points are wrapped in greased tape and marked tested March 2015 at 4 ohms. MPI was not done on shell-to-bottom welds because coating remains. Shell paint is cracked in several places. One isolated pit about 3 mm deep is on second course southwest by the automatic gauge. Gauge pipe is perforated at the top. Several stair treads attach across shell butt-weld joints, recorded against API 650 guidance. Roof has scattered topside pits up to 2 mm; coated areas are assessed stopped. Curb angle is 50–70 mm originally, with about 20 mm left beside roof plate 12.

4 in inlet + 10 in outlet, 6 o’clock support contacts: scale corr; supports perforated/corroded. Edge projection no plinth seal. Earth points grease-tape wrapped; test mark Mar 2015, 4 ohms. Shell-bottom MPI not done—coated. Shell coating cracks several spots. 2nd course SW near auto gauge: isolated pit ~3 mm. Auto gauge pipe top perforated. Several stair treads cross butt-weld joints, API 650 issue. Roof scattered topside pits to ~2 mm, coated/stopped. Curb angle 50–70 mm, local remaining ~20 mm next to plate 12.

Curb angle beside plate 12 has about 20 mm left versus 50–70 mm width; roof pits scattered to 2 mm and are coated, corrosion assessed stopped. Stair tread attachments cross shell butt welds, an API 650 issue. Gauge pipe perforated at top; second course southwest near gauge has one 3 mm pit. Shell paint cracked in several areas. Couldn’t do MPI on coated shell-bottom welds. Earth points are grease-tape wrapped with March 2015 / 4-ohm mark. No plinth seal at edge plate. Four-inch inlet and ten-inch outlet have scaling at six o’clock contacts, supports perforated and corroded.

Pipework: four-inch inlet and ten-inch outlet, corrosion and scale at six o’clock where they sit on supports; the supports themselves are perforated and corroded. Edge plate has no plinth seal. Earth points wrapped in greased fabric, tag says tested March 2015, four ohms. No MPI on the shell-to-bottom weld—coating prevented it. Shell coating cracked at several spots. Southwest second course near automatic gauge has isolated pit, about 3 millimetres. Automatic gauge pipe perforated up high. Several stair treads are welded over the shell butt joints; recorded contrary to API 650. Roof scattered topside pits maximum about 2 millimetres, now coated and assessed stopped. Curb angle is 50 to 70 millimetres, locally only about 20 left next to plate 12.

Pipes/supports: 4 in inlet + 10 in outlet / 6 o’clock contacts / scale corr / supports perforated. Foundation: edge projection no plinth seal. Earthing: greased tape / tested Mar-2015 / 4 ohms. Shell-bottom weld MPI: NOT done, coated. Shell paint: cracked several locations. Shell course 2 SW by gauge: isolated pit ~3 mm. Gauge pipe top: perforated. Stair treads: several across butt-weld joints / API 650 issue. Roof: scattered topside pits <=2 mm / coated / stopped. Curb angle at plate 12: width 50–70 mm; remaining ~20 mm local.

Piping: four-inch inlet and ten-inch outlet have scaled corrosion at six o’clock contacts; supports are perforated/corroded. Foundation: edge projection lacks plinth seal; earthing points are grease-tape wrapped and marked March 2015 at 4 ohms; MPI not performed on coated shell-bottom welds. Shell: coating cracks at several locations and one southwest second-course pit near gauge is about 3 mm. Appurtenance: gauge pipe perforated at top. Access: several stair treads cross butt-weld joints, flagged against API 650. Roof: scattered topside pits to 2 mm are coated and assessed stopped; curb angle is 50–70 mm, locally about 20 mm remaining beside plate 12.
